description: This file defines the Reward controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages the display of reward points related to a customer's account, including retrieving reward data, setting up page metadata, breadcrumbs, pagination, and rendering the reward view template.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class responsible for displaying the customer reward points page in the account section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles setting up the reward points page, including checks for login validation, preparing data, retrieving rewards, pagination, and rendering the view.
